title: NVIDIA BioNeMo accelerates Anthropic Claude Science
summary: Anthropic's Claude Science platform integrates NVIDIA's BioNeMo Agent Toolkit to provide computational life sciences researchers with an AI-powered workbench that enables natural language interaction with digital agents for executing end-to-end scientific research workflows.
problem_solved: Accelerates computational life sciences research by enabling scientists to use natural language to interact with AI agents for complex research workflows.
why_valuable: Bridges the gap between AI capabilities and scientific research by providing an accessible interface for executing sophisticated computational biology workflows without requiring deep technical expertise.
